figures.label: Figure 1
source_locators: Main PDF p.2 / printed 1529, Figure 1 legend and caption
figures.caption_paraphrase: Size-distribution curves for double-jet and the 0.063, 0.125 and 0.250 M microemulsion series.
figures.sample_scope: Figure 1 double-jet curve is a cohort distribution, not the Figure 2 representative HREM particle. Legend maps three microemulsion curves to AgNO3 concentrations; the text supplies one pooled 6–8 nm majority interval, not three individual means.
quantitative_facts: Double-jet cohort: 63% of particles 3–7 nm; pooled microemulsion group: majority 6–8 nm, irrespective of AgNO3 concentration.
gaps: Distribution curves not digitized as exact mean sizes.
